import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'

primitive = repo / 'tests/fixtures/primitive_parity/main.fzy'
primitive_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'parity', str(primitive), '--seed', '4242', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
primitive_payload = json.loads(primitive_proc.stdout.strip())
assert primitive_proc.returncode == 0, (primitive_proc.returncode, primitive_payload, primitive_proc.stderr)
assert primitive_payload['ok'] is True, primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['kind'] == 'executable', primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['checks']['sameExitCode'] is True, primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['checks']['sameStdout'] is True, primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['checks']['sameStderr'] is True, primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['checks']['sameVerifierResult'] is True, primitive_payload
assert primitive_payload['backendCapabilities']['cranelift']['unsupported'][0]['feature'] == 'async_c_export_surface', primitive_payload

native = repo / 'tests/fixtures/native_completeness/main.fzy'
native_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'parity', str(native), '--seed', '99', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
native_payload = json.loads(native_proc.stdout.strip())
assert native_proc.returncode == 0, (native_proc.returncode, native_payload, native_proc.stderr)
assert native_payload['ok'] is True, native_payload
assert native_payload['checks']['sameRuntimeBehavior'] is True, native_payload

root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-parity-lib-'))
(root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]\nname="parity_lib"\nversion="0.1.0"\n\n[target.lib]\nname="parity_lib"\npath="src/lib.fzy"\n')
(root / 'src/lib.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''\
    #[ffi_panic(abort)]
    pubext c fn add(left: i32, right: i32) -> i32 {
        return left + right
    }

    #[ffi_panic(abort)]
    pubext c fn mul(left: i32, right: i32) -> i32 {
        return left * right
    }
'''))
lib_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'parity', str(root), '--seed', '17', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
lib_payload = json.loads(lib_proc.stdout.strip())
assert lib_proc.returncode == 0, (lib_proc.returncode, lib_payload, lib_proc.stderr)
assert lib_payload['ok'] is True, lib_payload
assert lib_payload['kind'] == 'library', lib_payload
assert lib_payload['checks']['sameStaticExports'] is True, lib_payload
assert lib_payload['checks']['sameSharedExports'] is True, lib_payload

canary = repo / 'frameworklib/fzweb'
llvm_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(canary), '--backend', 'llvm', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
llvm_payload = json.loads(llvm_proc.stdout.strip())
assert llvm_proc.returncode == 0, (llvm_proc.returncode, llvm_payload, llvm_proc.stderr)
assert llvm_payload['status'] == 'ok', llvm_payload
clif_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(canary), '--backend', 'cranelift', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
clif_payload = json.loads(clif_proc.stdout.strip())
assert clif_proc.returncode == 0, (clif_proc.returncode, clif_payload, clif_proc.stderr)
assert clif_payload['status'] == 'ok', clif_payload
print('compiler-backend-parity-ok')
